scope: Proposition 1.2 (Signed finite-band estimate) of the manuscript “An Endpoint Gradient Bound for the Centered Disk Maximal Operator” (preprints/An-Endpoint-Gradient-Bound-for-the-Centered-Disk-Maximal-Operator-September-26-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 085 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d7a9062663c2c8f1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an absolute constant C such that, for every real g ∈ C∞ c (R2) and 0 < a ≤ b with b/a a power of two, including one, Z R2 |∇Sa,bg| dx ≤ C Z R2 |∇g| dx. (1.2) The constant is independent of a, b, and the number of dyadic radius scales between them.
